sources.file: Sample Space and Relative Frequency Test.docx

corrections: Sample Space Q23: blue is 2/25, not the keyed 2/23.
Sample Space Q27: WA relative frequency is 13/80 = 0.1625, not 0.26; Tasmania is 11/80 = 0.1375, not 0.22.
notes: All 70 source questions are retained and numbered in source order. Shared diagrams and tables are repeated independently for randomised practice.
All questions have checked worked solutions and automatic MCQ or typed result checks.

Source year is retained separately from 2026 curriculum placement. Conditional probability (Further Q30, Q35 and Q40) is placed in Year 10. Basic sample-space work is Year 7; complements and combined events are Year 8.
Repeated-colour sample space is entered as sector counts; repeated letter tiles remain separate physical outcomes.
Birth-day model, raffle winner count and garbage service-day assumptions are explicit.
Ambiguous “not red or blue” is clarified as neither, consistent with the source key.
Marks are practice allocations because the source tests do not print mark allocations.
